description: Place media on the timeline. A/V media lands as a linked pair on a video and an audio track. Default: the whole media, after the last clip, overwriting. A picture is scaled to fit the frame (a small logo fills it edge to edge); clip.set_transform {fit: "none"} keeps its own pixel size. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

after_clip_id.description: Start where this clip ends (instead of at_frame)

at_frame.description: Where the clip starts. Default: after the last clip

av.description: linked: video and audio as a link group; video or audio: only that part

duration_frames.description: Length for stills (default 5 s); ignored when source is given

link_track_id.description: Track for the other half of a linked clip. Default: the first track of that kind

media_id.description: Media handle from media.import or a create.* tool

mode.description: overwrite replaces what is underneath; insert pushes later clips right

nested_timeline_id.description: Instead of media: nest another timeline as one clip (a compound clip)

other_tracks.description: What the other tracks do when this edit moves later clips on the clip's own tracks (linked clips always move with it). stay: they don't move, and the result warns which clips there now play early or late. sync: they get the same change, so titles, overlays and sound stay in step: time taken out here comes out of them too (like range.extract), time added here opens the same gap in them (clips crossing that point are split, as insert does). Locked tracks always stay

preview.description: inline: image in the result; link: URI that renders on read; none

anyOf.description: Transcript words i to j (inclusive), from media.get include transcript

source.description: Source range in sequence frames, out exclusive. Default: the whole media

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

track_id.description: Track for the clip; a linked A/V clip puts its other half on link_track_id

name: clip.add

parent.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

frames.description: Frames shown; for a waveform, the start and end of its span

loudness.description: Measured for audio edits, over the waveform span

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

title: Add clip
